usedFor: Memberful holds members, and Google AI Studio (Gemini) writes from a prompt through “Generate Content” after a subscription event.

bestTemplate.name: “When a subscription is renewed” in Memberful, then “Generate Content” in Google AI Studio (Gemini)
bestTemplate.why: A renewal carries the member and subscription details, which gives the prompt real facts to write from.

watchOut: “When a subscription is updated” fires on every change, so “Generate Content” can run again for the same subscription.
